bearingSource: OSM way 606021762 long axis 32.0°; +X = NNE towards the three-sided apse, the tower projects at the SSW end (−X) and the sacristy lies on the WNW side (−Z), as in the OSM outline and photos 01–04.
approximations: Heights estimated from photo proportions with the 5.1 m tower width as scale (nave eaves ≈ 5.6 m, roof ≈ 47°, tower cornice ≈ 12.6 m, cross ≈ 20.8 m); helm stations taken from the upward photos 01/04 and stretched slightly. The ESE side was not photographed (windows and pilasters mirrored). The sacristy is modelled 2.4 m deep after photo 02 (OSM shows only a 1.3 m step). The gallery stair canopy, the wooden gate, the façade lettering and the churchyard fence are omitted.

note.ro: Machetă interpretată după fotografii de referință publice și conturul OSM; înălțimile sunt estimate, iar latura dinspre est-sud-est este presupusă. Coiful octogonal al turnului (bulb, lanternă, bulb superior), din cupru furnizat de COLOR METAL conform evidențelor sale, este redat așa cum apare în fotografiile din 2021; crucea și globul sunt redate din alamă.
note.hu: Nyilvános referenciafotók és az OSM-alaprajz alapján értelmezett makett; a magasságok becsültek, a kelet-délkeleti oldal feltételezett. A COLOR METAL nyilvántartása szerint általa szállított rézzel fedett nyolcszögletű toronysisak (hagyma, lámpás, felső hagyma) a 2021-es fotók szerinti állapotában látható; a kereszt és a gömb sárgarézként jelenik meg.
note.en: Scale model interpreted from public reference photographs and the OSM outline; heights are estimated and the east-south-east side is assumed. The octagonal tower helm (onion, lantern, upper onion), in copper supplied by COLOR METAL according to its records, is shown as photographed in 2021; the cross and ball are shown in brass.
